note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Static assertions are regex contracts over SKILL.md; live assertions need a real repo + operator feedback and are recorded as not-run.

evals.prompt: Run /iiib-iterate-after-build with: the save button crashes with a console error after the latest build.
evals.expected_output: The item is classified as Bug lane, routed to diagnosing-bugs plus debugging-and-error-recovery, root cause named before any fix, minimal fix applied, code-simplification run, one local commit created, no push, no PR, verification reported in the final report.

static_assertions.why: the bug lane must exist as a routing option
bugs must go through the full diagnosis loop before fixing

static_assertions.pattern: Name the root cause.*not the symptom
static_assertions.why: no fix without a named root cause
Station IIIB must never push — that's Station IV's job
commit format is a contract downstream stations depend on
every report must hand off to Station IV

live_assertions: The item is classified into the Bug lane with an observable reason
Root cause is named before the fix is applied
Exactly one local commit is created for the fix
No push to origin and no PR is opened

evals.prompt: Run /iiib-iterate-after-build with: the title is off-center on mobile, otherwise everything works.
evals.expected_output: The item is classified as UI lane, routed to frontend-ui-engineering, rebuilt minimally, verified with a browser check at mobile width, committed locally, reported .

static_assertions.why: the UI lane must exist as a routing option
UI items must route to the frontend skill
UI fixes must be verified in a real browser
every fix gets a simplification pass

live_assertions: The item is classified into the UI lane with an observable reason
The fix is implemented without debugging ceremony
No push to origin and no PR is opened

evals.prompt: Run /iiib-iterate-after-build with: the submit button does nothing when clicked, no error in console.
evals.expected_output: The item is classified as Dead button lane, routed to click-path-audit checklist, handler call chain traced, state-undoing write found, fix applied at the shared root, committed locally.

static_assertions.why: dead buttons are a distinct lane from bugs — no error shown
dead buttons follow the click-path-audit checklist
the procedure is trace-first, not guess-first

live_assertions: The item is classified into the Dead button lane
The handler call chain is traced before any fix
The fix targets the state write that undoes an earlier one

evals.prompt: Run /iiib-iterate-after-build with any correction list on a clean checkout.
evals.expected_output: The skill must never push or open a PR: all fixes stay as local commits and the handoff goes to /iv-review-build-and-pr.

static_assertions.why: pushing is Station IV's exclusive responsibility
PR opening is Station IV's exclusive responsibility
the handoff must go to Station IV
guardrails must be respected during iteration

static_assertions.pattern: Never touch code outside the reported items
static_assertions.why: only fix what the operator reported

live_assertions: The handoff directs the operator to /iv-review-build-and-pr
